name: Glade of the Powerfull
description: A very peacefull glade, in the middle of the forrest with a well

items.water of the brave: Give a dose of courage before a new quest

dialogue:
Welcome to Devas's forrest!
To begin, I have an enigm for you, will you be able to find the response?
I always run but never walk, often murmur but never talk, have a bed but never sleep, have a mouth but never eat. What am I?
You can come back later young player
Really good, you can now follow the south direction to go to the village of Devas
